# Portfolio

> Official portfolio of inbo, a Roblox Luau developer and UI designer documenting multiplayer games, gameplay systems, and cartoon simulator interfaces.

Canonical site: https://inbodev.com/
Scripter portfolio: https://inbodev.com/script
UI design portfolio: https://inbodev.com/ui
Projects: https://inbodev.com/#projects
Skills: https://inbodev.com/#skills
Pricing: https://inbodev.com/#pricing
Verified client reviews: https://inbodev.com/#testimonials
Contact: https://inbodev.com/#contact

The portfolio includes 12 documented project case studies and a dedicated UI design portfolio covering simulator inventory systems, in-game store bundles, HUDs, server controlled combat, multiplayer round systems, data persistence, movement, physics, economy, and progression systems. Each case study includes a demonstration video, technical summary, and technologies used.

Primary technologies: Roblox, Luau, UI Design, Rojo, Git, ProfileService, DataStore, RemoteEvents, and server validation.
